says: The comment in .agents/tsconfig.json says '.agents/ is no workspace package', but pnpm-workspace.yaml lists .agents as one and .agents/package.json gives it its own typecheck script.
proof: .agents/tsconfig.json:3-4: '`.agents/` is no workspace package: its imports resolve from the root's own dependencies.' pnpm-workspace.yaml lists '- .agents' under packages, with the comment 'the skills and the lead's own scripts, type-checked here (ticket 486)'. pnpm -r ls --depth -1 --json prints a package whose path ends in /.agents.
cost: A reader of the tsconfig is told the wrong thing about how .agents/ is built and may treat it as outside pnpm's workspace when changing its dependencies or scripts.
